title: Partial Data & Error Handling
description: Handle partial data failures and complex error scenarios in Apollo Client applications.

data.text: Partial data occurs when some fields in a GraphQL response fail while others succeed. This is common with batched queries or when using fragments across multiple entity types. Handling partial data requires knowing which fields are reliable and which are not.

data.title: Partial data handling
data.content: Handling partial data in a dashboard query.

data.text: Use React error boundaries to catch rendering errors from unexpected data shapes. Combine with Apollo error policies for a comprehensive error handling strategy.
Never show raw GraphQL error messages to users. Log them for debugging, but display friendly messages like "Something went wrong" or "Please try again later."
data.title: User Experience
Partial Data & Error Handling Key Points
points: Partial data is common with errorPolicy: all.
Check error paths to identify failed fields.
Use error boundaries for unexpected rendering errors.
data.takeaway: Graceful error handling makes your Apollo Client application resilient and user-friendly.
